messages:
maria: quick handoff — we need SM occupancy, GPU memory used, and queue_depth surfaced per-pool (hosted + dedicated) for the new capacity dashboard. Console + Billing asked for p50/p90/p99 and 1m/5m windows. sketch below.

maria: proposed metric names / labels:
```
redwood_gpu_sm_occupancy{pool=\"hosted|dedicated\", gpu=..., model_family=...}
redwood_gpu_memory_bytes_used{pool=..., node=..., gpu=...}
redwood_gpu_queue_depth{pool=..., queue=\"sm|io|batcher\", priority=\"low|normal|high\"}
```

maria: aggregation plan: 1m raw -> 5m sliding with p50/p90/p99. dedicated also needs per-tenant aggregation (billing). hosted should be aggregated by region + model_family.

junior question from jonathan: how do we handle continuous batching and prefix/KV cache effects on occupancy? raw SM occupancy will vary a lot.

rohit: good point. runtime will emit two occupancy flavors: `sm_occupancy_inflight` (current warps/active slots) and `sm_effective_occupancy` which divides by effective_batch_size to normalize. propose:
```
sm_effective_occupancy = sm_occupancy_inflight / max(1, effective_batch_size)
```
will include `effective_batch_size` label (int).

jonathan: cardinality concerns — per-tenant label for dedicated could be huge. we should avoid unbounded labels.

ashley: +1 on cardinality. proposal: for billing we emit `tenant_bucket` (hash mod 256) and a `tenant_id` only to the internal billing store (not in Prometheus scraped metrics). dedicated internal metrics pipeline can keep full tenant mapping for a rolling 7d window.

maria: sounds reasonable. summary for retention: raw high-card metrics (hosted region/model_family, dedicated per-node) retained 7d; aggregated 5m p50/p90/p99 retained 30d for console; billing aggregates (per-tenant totals) retained 90d.

ashley: alerts — initial thresholds idea: queue_depth > 50 sustained > 5m -> paging; sm_effective_occupancy p99 > 0.95 for 2m -> warning. will draft runbook.

linda: who owns dashboard visuals? we need heatmap by pool + per-host peek, plus a table for top tenants by GPU minutes. want a small UX note: show hosted and dedicated toggles and ability to drill to node.

maria: dashboard owner: platform UI (maria) will wire visuals. runtime owners: rohit to add metrics & labels. eng-sre (ashley) to propose alerts + runbook. billing (jonathan) to confirm tenant_bucket approach and mapping.

sre-bot: deploy: runtime v3.8.2 -> metrics branch merged. `redwood_gpu_sm_occupancy` and `sm_effective_occupancy` metrics are in the canary.

rohit: FYI — canary will emit with `pool=dummy` until we flip config. testing notes: please exercise hosted and dedicated flows, and send logs for any missing labels.

jonathan: for billing mapping — i'll prototype a small job that reads the high-card mapping from the internal pipeline and emits daily per-tenant totals into our billing DB. will share schema by EOD Thu.

ashley: i'll draft alert thresholds & runbook tomorrow, pinging oncall for feedback.

maria: action items + timeline: rohit -> land metrics in runtime canary (today). maria -> mock dashboard in console (this week). ashley -> alerts + runbook (by Fri). jonathan -> billing mapping prototype (Thu). sync: Friday 10:00am PT to reconcile dashboards + alerts.

linda: sgtm. :thumbsup:

jonathan: one more ask — add `model_family` label where possible so we can correlate occupancy to model type. helps routing team for fallback policies.

rohit: will add `model_family` where runtime knows it; otherwise `unknown`.

maria: great. thanks all — i'll follow up with the dashboard tickets and a short PROD checklist for the canary.

ashley: +1, thanks.

maria: tagging for visibility: @eng-sre @eng-runtime @eng-billing @eng-platform
